title: 三个年龄段的日本小孩参与活动对比
question: The bar chart below shows the percentages of three groups of Japanese children taking part in four kinds of activities in 2018. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
logic: ▪ 概述 不同年龄段的偏好 + 共同最低项【低龄儿童的偏好】5–8 岁和9–11 岁：看电视最受欢迎（the most popular activity）→ 【较大儿童的偏好】12–16 岁：骑自行车参与率最高（attracted the highest percentage）→ 【共同低值】玩电脑游戏：三个年龄段中均为最不受欢迎的活动（the least popular activity across all three age groups） ▪ 主一段 看电视 + 骑自行车——突出不同年龄段的最高值【先讲看电视：全图最高值】5–8 岁看电视比例超过 90% → 全图最高（the highest figure across the board）→ 【对比另外两个年龄段】两个较大年龄组均为80%， 比例相同（both stood at exactly 80%）→ 【转向骑自行车：最大年龄组的首选活动】12–16 岁参与率超过80% → 【补充其他两组】5–8 岁约65%，9–11 岁约62% ▪ 主二段 电脑游戏 + 阅读——对比年龄变化规律【先讲电脑游戏：年龄越大，参与率越低】参与率随年龄增长而 下降（decreased with age）→ 三个年龄组呈递减趋势：60% → 约55% → 40% → 【转向阅读：与电脑游戏的 年龄规律形成对比】最小年龄组阅读比例最低（the lowest figure in its category）→ 两个较大年龄组参与率相近 （the figures for the two older groups were similar），均约70%

source_nine.en: The column chart compares the proportions of Japanese children in three different age brackets who took part in four kinds of activities in 2018.

source_nine.en: Overall, watching TV was the most popular activity among those aged 5 to 8 and 9 to 11, while riding a bike attracted the highest percentage of children in the 12-to-16 age group. By contrast, playing computer games remained the least popular activity across all three age groups.
source_nine.cn: 总体来看，看电视是5 至8 岁和9 至11 岁儿童中最受欢迎的活动，而骑自行车则在12 至16 岁儿童中拥有最高的参 与比例。相比之下，玩电脑游戏在所有三个年龄组中都是参与比例最低的活动。

source_nine.en: More than 90% of children aged 5 to 8 watched TV, representing the highest figure across the board. Meanwhile, the proportions for the two older groups both stood at exactly 80%. By comparison, just over 80% of those aged 12 to 16 rode a bike, compared with approximately 65% of the youngest group and around 62% of those aged 9 to 11.
source_nine.cn: 在5 至8 岁的儿童中，超过90%的人看电视，这是整张图表中的最高比例。与此同时，另外两个年龄组看电视的比例 均为80%。相比之下，在12 至16 岁的儿童中，略高于80%的人骑自行车，而最年轻年龄组的这一比例约为65%，9 至11 岁儿童的比例则约为62%。

source_nine.en: The percentage of children playing computer games decreased with age. Exactly 60% of those aged 5 to 8 played games, compared with around 55% of 9-to-11-year-olds and 40% of the oldest group. Turning to reading, slightly more than 60% of children aged 5 to 8 engaged in this activity, the lowest figure in its category, while the figures for the two older groups were similar, at around 70%.
source_nine.cn: 玩电脑游戏的儿童比例随着年龄增长而下降。5 至8 岁儿童中恰好有60%的人玩电脑游戏，而9 至11 岁儿童的比例 约为55%，年龄最大的群体则为40%。至于阅读，5 至8 岁儿童中略高于60%的人参与这项活动，是三个年龄组中阅 读比例最低的；而另外两个年龄组的比例较为接近，均在70%左右。
